109.description: This vector represents common suffixes, syllables, and grammatical endings frequently found in Romance languages and proper nouns.

12.description: This vector represents Thai language characters, diacritics, and phonemes.

182.description: This vector represents the Thai consonant letter "ต" (to tao) appearing as a subword or character component across various Thai words.

99.description: This vector represents the set of consonant characters in the Thai alphabet.

138.description: This vector represents common Thai linguistic sub-word tokens and prefixes, often associated with the verb 'to be' (เป็น) or similar structural particles, mixed with English article fragments.

78.description: These tokens represent Thai vowel signs and tonal diacritics combined with consonant clusters.

90.description: This vector activates on capitalized and lowercase word-initial consonant clusters and bigrams.

33.description: This vector activates on short character sequences, prefixes, and multilingual subwords starting with the letters 'm', 'a', or 'h'.

39.description: This feature vector activates on subwords, characters, and fragments related to Thai script and romanized lexical roots.

118.description: This vector activates for tokens containing the letters "k" and "kk" across various scripts and romanizations.
